key_facts: The team presented a remote control shaped like a banana with a rubber casing.
The remote control includes a scroll wheel, pushbuttons, an LCD display, and voice recognition capabilities.
The team considered adding a mute button but decided against it due to budget constraints.
The remote control was designed to be locatable with a beep feature, but the locator was removed due to cost.
The team evaluated the design using a seven-point scale, with most criteria receiving a score of seven except for some aspects like intuitiveness and ergonomic design which received lower scores.
The production costs were adjusted to fit within the budget, resulting in a final cost that was well within the allocated funds.
The team discussed the possibility of a patent for the remote control design.
The team acknowledged the design was not fully intuitive and had some ergonomic considerations for left-handed users.
The team expressed satisfaction with the overall design and its functionality despite some compromises made during the development process.
